verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack documents no user-definable event→action rules in Bolt itself. Automatic GitHub commit sync is a fixed built-in behavior, not a rule a user defines. Skills are reusable instructions, not event triggers. Supabase edge functions are third-party developer building blocks, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
